basicInfo.name: Sunran
basicInfo.flavor: There was nothing Sunran's skyward-reaching blade could not cleave. With no means to counter it, her blade was regarded as judgment itself, delivered from the heavens.

Normal Attack.desc:
Single Enemy
 - Deals damage equal to 145% of Physical Attack 1 time(s).
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 145% of Physical Attack.

Skill 1.name: Chained Slash
Skill 1.desc:
3 Enemies (Back Row First)
 - Deals damage equal to 51% of Physical Attack 3 time(s).
 - Each attack deals additional damage equal to 19% of Physical Attack for every 3 stack(s) of [Demon Face]. [Max 6 Stack(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 51% of Physical Attack.
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - Changes Number of Targets: To 4 Enemies

Skill 2.name: Phantom Flying Blade
Skill 2.desc:
3 Enemies (Back Row First)
 - 100% chance to inflict 2 Buff Removal(s).
 - Deals damage equal to 55% of Physical Attack plus 7% of the target's Max HP 3 time(s). (HP-based damage limited to 100% of caster's Attack)
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 55% of Physical Attack.
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - Changes Number of Targets: To 4 Enemies

Passive.name: Demon-Faced Warrior
Passive.desc:
Self
 - Grants Upper Hand. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]
 - Revives with 100% HP upon falling in battle. [Once per Battle]
 - Grants Upper Hand upon revival. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - Grants 1 stack(s) of Demon Face upon being hit 3 time(s) by an enemy's attack. [Max 6 Stack(s)] (If deployed to a team with 3 or more Attack heroes.)
 - After activating a skill 2 time(s), Upper Hand duration increases by 1 turn(s). If you do not have Upper Hand, gain Upper Hand for 1 turn(s). (When the duration increases, it cannot exceed the buff's original maximum turns.)
 - All Allies
 - Grants Physical Attack Boost. [Always Active]
 - 3 Enemies (Back Row First)
 - Grants [Phantom Flying Blade] when you have 6 stack(s) of [Demon Face]. [Once per Battle]
 - 100% chance to inflict 2 Buff Removal(s).
 - Deals damage equal to 55% of Physical Attack plus 7% of the target's Max HP 3 time(s). (HP-based damage limited to 100% of caster's Attack)
 - *Skills triggered this way are treated as separate from the original skill.
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - Changes Number of Targets: To 4 Enemies
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Starts battle with 3 stack(s) of Demon Face.
 - Adds Effect: 100% Weakness Hit Chance Boost. [Always Active]

Awaken Skill.name: Empyrean Sword
Awaken Skill.desc:
All Enemies
 - Deals damage equal to 117% of Physical Attack plus 9% of the target's Max HP 2 time(s). (HP-based damage limited to 100% of caster's Attack)
 - Deals Piercing damage equal to 117% of Physical Attack plus 9% of the target's Max HP 2 time(s). (HP-based damage limited to 100% of caster's Attack.)
 - Damage increases by up to 100% proportional to the target's current HP when you have 6 stack(s) of [Demon Face].
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Adds Effect: Pierce
